title: Thunderbird fails to forward when using filters from 2 of my 7 accounts
creator: danny.crump
content:
I have two domain accounts; crumpcorp.com and dannycrump.com with GoDaddy. I have two E-mail accounts; danny.crump@crumpcorp.com and mail@dannycrump.com. I use Thunderbird desktop Email. Thunderbird has the ability of use filters to perform automatic actions on messages received. One of the filters is “Forward Message To”. Unfortunately, attempting to forward messages fails. Thunderbird displays the following message:

Sending of the message failed. An error occurred while sending mail. The mail server responded: Request failed; Mailbox unavailable. Please verify that your email address is correct in your account settings and try again.

Please help with this issue.

Please respond to mail@dannycrump.com
